pages.text: Consisting of varied subspecies of Enderman, these odd creatures appear to defend something from the End, and are more hostile than their main counterpart.

While they share many traits, such as vulnerability to water, they appear to be more tolerant towards Endermites, and teleport less frequently. Some might disappear for a time after teleporting, before reappearing to confuse their foes.
Unfortunately, the book is incapable of showing their eyes properly for some arcane reason.
Accounted as being the creepiest looking, Watchlings are noted to prefer defending their home in simple ways, namely smashing and swinging at their foes with their big arms.

The most resilient of Enderlings, these fiery entities shoot volleys of hot goo at their foes, though if a foe gets close to them or get hurt by them, they would stop their attack and temporarily run or teleport away.

Similar to Web Spiders, these creatures will attempt to trap their foes in their web-like goop before attacking them with their pinwheel like arms. Unlike their brethren, these strange beings won't disappear for a time when teleporting, preferring to teleport away in an instant.
